description: This PHP class 'Crc32ValidatingParser' decorates an existing parser to validate the CRC32 checksum from the 'x-amz-crc32' header in AWS SDK HTTP responses. It ensures data integrity by comparing the expected checksum with the computed one and throws an exception on mismatch.

classes.name: Crc32ValidatingParser
classes.description: A decorator class for an AWS SDK parser that adds CRC32 checksum validation for responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a callable parser to decorate.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Validates the 'x-amz-crc32' header in the response by comparing it with the computed checksum and throws an exception if they do not match. Then delegates parsing to the wrapped parser.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from the stream to the wrapped parser.
